text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to teach the world that 
wonderful surprises exist— and to do so, 
the path Marvelous Sunday chose was to run 
in races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While soothing her alongside her close 
Umamusume friends—since she'd run off to 
the ends of the earth if left alone—we 
proceeded with the training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, at Tracen Academy, packed with 
top-tier talent, Description: ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To deliver Marvelous to the entire world, 
the days of working hand-in-hand with 
her—the "Global Marvelous Project"—were 
about to begin.
